recognize_zh: 周邊血液中出現高核質比、染色質細緻均勻、細胞質僅剩一圈淡藍色的母細胞（blasts），同時背景血小板與白血球都很少；單看型態無法分辨 B 淋巴母細胞或骨髓母細胞，須靠流式確認，此例為 Ph+ B-ALL。
features: Circulating blasts with very high N:C ratio and a thin rim of pale blue agranular cytoplasm
Nuclei round (right panel) to irregular/angular (left, larger cell) with fine, homogeneous chromatin
Nucleoli inconspicuous; no Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules
Background shows few platelets and no mature leukocytes in these fields, consistent with pancytopenia
Red cells largely normocytic with mild anisocytosis and an occasional echinocyte
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows scattered circulating blasts in a background with markedly reduced platelets and leukocytes. The blasts are small to intermediate in size, with very high N:C ratio, round to irregular nuclei, finely dispersed homogeneous chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli, and a scant rim of agranular pale blue cytoplasm; Auer rods are not seen. Red cells show mild anisocytosis without significant schistocytes or nucleated red cells. Findings are consistent with acute leukemia with peripheral blood involvement; morphology does not permit lineage assignment, and flow cytometry demonstrating a B-lymphoblast phenotype with BCR::ABL1 on cytogenetics supports Ph-positive B-lymphoblastic leukemia.

ddx.vs: AML with minimal differentiation also has agranular blasts without Auer rods; separation requires flow cytometry (CD13/CD33/CD117 without B-lineage markers) rather than morphology.
Reactive lymphocytes have more abundant cytoplasm and condensed chromatin, and hematogones are rare in blood and show a maturing, non-aberrant immunophenotype.

ddx.dx: Leukemic phase of large B-cell or mantle cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Lymphoma cells usually have more clumped chromatin, visible nucleoli or nuclear clefts, and a mature TdT-negative, surface light chain restricted phenotype.
Also BCR::ABL1-positive; suggested by basophilia, left-shifted granulocytes, and p210 transcript, features not present in this pancytopenic smear.
